title: Hello World
prompt:
Your first JavaScript program: print a message to the console.

  • In the JavaScript editor, call console.log with the text Hello world (capital H, lowercase w).
  • Press Run / Restart and check the Console panel — you should see the message there.
  • Then press Grade.

html.starter: Look at the Console panel after you Run.

javascript.starter: // Print Hello world to the console

tests.name: console.log Hello world
tests.feedback: Add console.log("Hello world"); then Run before grading.

solution.javascript:
// Print Hello world to the console

console.log("Hello world");
